_note: Typed vocabulary proposals for substrate-ui's window, main and server vocabulary (grammar/PRINCIPLES.md taxonomy). Ratified proposals bump the version; open ones carry their reason.

proposals.element: Workspace: the app's notion and the kernel's are one entity; the kernel is its home; app tags carry workspace path and do not redeclare its kinds.
proposals.source: kernel SessionManifest.workspace; server /api/workspaces; WORKING_AGREEMENT.md (substrate-ui never redeclares kernel names)
proposals.rationale: The app reads and shows the kernel's sessions; a second definition would split one thing in two and break the join to the record.

First signal of an app launch: which build and vocabulary is running and which store it uses. Opens the AppBoot session; every other tag of the launch carries its boot_id.
Quit began. cause: menu, last_window, signal, update.
The launch ended; the server's exit and the trace's write and loss counts. Closes the AppBoot session.
Main started the server process.
The server reported its port; ms since spawn.
The server process ended. An incident when expected is false: the window has no backend.
Main created a window. cause: boot, menu, activate, second_instance, deep_link.
A window closed.
The window tried to leave the app's page and main refused it.
The OS passed a substrate:// link.
A native menu item fired and main sent its command to the window.
A native file dialog closed. dialog: pick_folder, open_record. outcome: picked, cancelled.
The window's page ran its boot and mounted App. Opens the Window session in the window's own trace.
The window's open view changed: panes, meta or a page. cause: key, button, menu, split, records_open, close.
A named key (never a typed character) was routed. action: the keymap action or none; target: picker, records, language, window, box.
The window opened one of its dialogs.
A window dialog closed. outcome: confirmed, cancelled, escape.
A pane was created. cause: start, split, run, delegate, restore.
A pane was removed.
Focus moved to a pane. cause: click, key, split, open.
An unbound pane took a session or record. binding: session or record; how: picker, attach, run, child, restore.
Meta's lens changed: stream, graph, structure, language, scene, io.
A record entry of a session became a row on screen. The view pair of every kernel session kind the window shows (kernel session vocabulary § G).
A record entry the pane received and chose not to draw, with why.
A folder was sent to the recent-workspace list. outcome: added, refused.
The length and tone picks were recorded for the next session.
A session's name changed. outcome: renamed, refused.
The person asked a background task to stop.
The window asked whether a CLI driver is signed in.
The sign-in card was shown for a CLI driver.
The sign-in card's flow ended. outcome: signed_in, failed, dismissed.
The server's boot scan finished and it serves; the store as found.
The server created a session for a window's open request.
The server accepted a turn and handed it to the kernel.
The server answered a request with an error. area: the domain (session, turn, workspace, files, records, cli, runs, tasks, assays, topology); cause: a short code, never the request's content.
An exception escaped a handler; the request failed with 500.
The server's shutdown ended its sessions and exited.
A process opened its trace file for this launch.
Lines that could not be written since the last line that was.
An emit broke the vocabulary (unknown tag, missing field). Raised in source builds; emitted in the packaged app.
A Layer 4–5 rule failed at runtime; context holds the recent trace and the state involved.
A pane attached a run record read-only. how: records_page, deep_link, open_record. outcome: attached, refused.

proposals.element: record_context: boot_id, process, proc_seq, wall, window_id, pane_id on every trace record, stamped by the emitter outside the payload
proposals.source: web/vm/signals/versions/0.6.json (no window tag carries a pane or window id); PLAN-2026-11-05-sdd-signals-r3.md item 2 (ordering by boot id and per-process sequence)
proposals.rationale: With two panes open no v0.6 tag says which pane it belongs to, and records from three processes cannot be ordered; one context block joins and orders every tag without renaming any.

A pane's drawn state changed, emitted when React commits (componentDidUpdate), not when state is set. state: picker, session, record. The view pair of the picker, session-open, stream, turn, driver and workspace tags.
A page committed its rows: records, assays, studio, settings. inert is true for a page with no endpoint behind it (studio). The view pair of the *_LOADED tags.
Where a pane's transcript sits after a change. cause: row_arrived, user, view_switch. Answers the follow-bottom question the 2026-10-02 postmortem found no gate could.

proposals.element: LENS_DRAWN (pane_id, lens, rows): what meta's stream, graph, structure, language, scene and i/o lenses drew
proposals.rationale: The lenses draw record data; v0.7 records only which lens is open (LENS_CHANGED), not what it drew.
proposals.reason_open: Each lens's draw unit differs (rows, nodes, bars); typed per lens when plan item 4 reaches meta.

proposals.element: Restate S1's server clause: SERVER_STARTED is the server's first record after its boot scan; records of requests served while the scan runs may precede it.
proposals.source: server.py main (the boot scan runs on a background thread after serving starts; lens audit F319); sprint 353
proposals.rationale: S1 says SERVER_STARTED is the server's first record, but its counts come from a scan that runs while the server already serves; once plan item 4 adds request records, S1 as written can fail on a correct run.
proposals.reason_open: Holds today (nothing in the server emits before the scan ends); settled in plan item 4 when the first request record lands.
proposals.withdrawn_by: P-0.8-SPLIT-SERVER_STARTED (agent-resolved 2026-11-06, sprint 354): SERVER_STARTED moves to the port bind, before serving, so S1 holds as written and needs no restating

proposals.element: SERVER_STARTED (port, sessions_found, parked, interrupted, ended) -> SERVER_STARTED (port), written at the port bind, and STORE_SCANNED (sessions_found, parked, interrupted, ended, skipped, duration_ms), written when the boot scan ends
proposals.source: server.py main: the boot scan runs on a background thread after the listeners start (F319); sprint 353 Rubber Duck
proposals.rationale: One tag named two events: the server starting and the store scan ending, seconds apart on a large store with requests served between them. As one tag, S1 (SERVER_STARTED first) and server_run (opened by SERVER_STARTED) fail on a correct run once requests emit. Split, each tag names one event and S1 holds unchanged in meaning; T2 (SERVER_BOUND to SERVER_STARTED within HEALTH_TIMEOUT_MS) now measures the bind, as its source does. skipped and duration_ms come from the scan's own print line.

proposals.element: SIGNAL_REJECTED gains optional field (the payload field at fault); problem gains wrong_type and out_of_range
proposals.source: plan item 3 (validation where the signal is spoken); evidence rules E5 (ranges) and field_types (Layer 2)
proposals.rationale: The checkers enforce field_types and E5, so a rejection must be able to say so; and a rejection that does not name the field leaves the reader to guess which of a tag's fields broke.

proposals.element: E4 names STORE_SCANNED where it named SERVER_STARTED; E5's target names its fields exactly
proposals.source: v0.8 split (P-0.8-SPLIT-SERVER_STARTED) moved the counts to STORE_SCANNED; E4 was not updated
proposals.rationale: Since v0.8, SERVER_STARTED carries only port; E4 as written asked it for outcome counts it no longer has. E5's 'ms' meant fields ending in _ms (duration_ms); the checkers need the exact rule.

proposals.element: RUN_FOCUS_REQUESTED.sessions typed 'list of {session_id, role, record_root, driven}' where v0.7 wrote 'int or list'
proposals.source: web/vm/session_controller.ts /run focus: sessions is the RunRow's RunSessionRow[] (web/vm/types.ts); found by the sprint 355 linter
proposals.rationale: The code sends a list on every path; 'int or list' named two types, which no checker reads, so every emit of the tag would have been rejected.

proposals.element: TURN_INTERRUPTED.signal typed bool where v0.7 wrote 'string or null'
proposals.source: web/vm/session_controller.ts interruptTurn: signal is result.data?.signal === true; the tag's own note says true for Ctrl+C, false for /interrupt; found by harness/shakeout/copy_key.ts under the sprint 355 rejection check
proposals.rationale: Sprint 350 Step 3 (e6d72a4) typed the field against its name, not its emit site; every interrupt would have been rejected.

proposals.element: SPEC_BUILT.status typed string where v0.7 wrote 'int (HTTP status)'
proposals.source: web/vm/session_controller.ts buildSpec: status is String(run.status ?? "unknown"); the tag's note: 'status is the Run's terminal or in-flight state'; found by the sprint 355 audit of every emit site against its declared types
proposals.rationale: Sprint 350 Step 3 typed status as an HTTP status by its name; every successful build would have been rejected.

proposals.element: APP_QUIT_REQUESTED.cause: enum app | last_window | startup_failed | backend_died, where v0.7 had menu | last_window | signal | update
proposals.source: electron/main.js: before-quit (app.quit from the app menu's quit role, the Dock, logout, Playwright), window-all-closed, the startup-failure path, onBackendDied (app.exit, which skips before-quit)
proposals.rationale: Electron's before-quit does not say who asked, so main cannot tell menu from the Dock or a test driver; 'app' names what it can know. Nothing in the app updates itself or traps a signal, so update and signal named events that cannot happen. startup_failed and backend_died are the two quits main starts itself and had no value.

proposals.element: WINDOW_OPENED.cause: enum boot | menu | activate, without second_instance and deep_link
proposals.source: electron/main.js: createWindow is called at boot, from File ▸ New Window and on activate; second-instance and open-url focus the current window
proposals.rationale: No code path opens a window for a second instance or a deep link; the two values named events that cannot happen.

proposals.element: SESSION_CREATED.workspace_shape: enum flat | worktree | isolate, where v0.7 had flat | worktree | sandbox | path
proposals.source: ../substrate/src/substrate/topologies/session_registry.py WorkspaceShape (FLAT, WORKTREE, ISOLATE); server.py _session_create sets isolate
proposals.rationale: Workspace is kernel-homed (ENTITY_MERGE_PROPOSED in v0.7); its shape values are the kernel's. sandbox and path are not kernel shapes, and isolate was missing, so every isolated session would have been rejected.

proposals.element: API_REFUSED.area and SERVER_FAULTED.area gain unrouted: an /api/ path no route serves
proposals.source: server.py do_GET/do_POST fall-through 404s; the window still calls /api/validate and /api/build, deleted from the server in 1e326db (2026-10-08)
proposals.rationale: A request to a path no route serves is a domain event (the window and the server disagree on the API); without a value it could not be written.

proposals.element: API_REFUSED.cause is the refusing handler and line (function:line)
proposals.source: server.py: 133 _error call sites and the direct 409/410 answers, each with free text
proposals.rationale: E1 forbids the response text (it can carry request content); a code per site names the line that decided, which is what a reader needs to find it. The text reaches the trace through the window's SESSION_OPEN_REFUSED and TURN_REFUSED detail, bounded by E2.

proposals.source: web/vm/session_controller.ts attachRecordRoot: a pane showing an attached record streams it with no session id (STREAM_ATTACHED carries record_root)
proposals.rationale: T4 asks every received entry to be drawn or skipped, in record panes too; a non-null session_id made those records unwritable.

proposals.element: TRANSCRIPT_ROW_SKIPPED.reason defined against the code: hidden_kind from KIND_DISPOSITION ignored, folded inside another row, duplicate_seq a replay, other a rendered kind with no row this time; emit sites named
proposals.source: web/vm/session_controller.ts KIND_DISPOSITION (every kernel kind rendered or ignored, exhaustive by type) and handleEnvelope; web/reveal/transcript/Transcript.tsx (tool results folded into their call's card)
proposals.rationale: v0.7 named the four reasons without saying which code decides each; a reader of a skip needs to know what the reason commits to.

proposals.source: web/reveal/transcript/useScrollAnchor.ts: a ResizeObserver on the scroller and the mount settles the view when content grows outside a React commit (a card opened, a font loaded) or the scroller changes size
proposals.rationale: v0.7 named three causes; the scroll owner moves the view for a fourth, and calling it row_arrived would say a record entry arrived when none did.

proposals.source: web/reveal/transcript/useScrollAnchor.ts pinRef: a clicked <summary> is held at its viewport offset in either mode until the user scrolls (sprint 075's caret pin)
proposals.rationale: While a header is pinned a following transcript is legitimately not at the bottom; without the field a reader cannot tell that from the follow-bottom regression of 2026-10-02.

proposals.element: E8: in TRANSCRIPT_SCROLLED, following and not pinned implies at_bottom
proposals.source: process/planning/POSTMORTEM-2026-10-02-transcript-follow-bottom-regression.md (no gate measured follow-bottom); useScrollAnchor.ts settle writes the bottom whenever following and not pinned
proposals.rationale: The postmortem's failure is exactly a pane that follows and is not at the bottom; stated as a rule, any trace shows it.

proposals.source: web/app/App.tsx: panes are made at start (state, the tweak sync), by split, openRunPanes and openSessionPane; nothing reopens panes on a reload, which restores pane 1's session only
proposals.rationale: A value names an event that can happen at its emit site (v0.10); a reload's restore is a binding, PANE_BOUND how restore.

proposals.source: web/app/keymap.ts has no key that moves focus between panes; App.tsx closePaneNow gives focus to the closed pane's neighbour
proposals.rationale: key could not happen; close happens on every ⌘W with more than one pane and had no value.

proposals.element: PANE_BOUND.how gains direct; bound defined as the pane no longer showing its picker
proposals.source: App.tsx computeViews session(p): a pane shows its transcript when the window marked it bound or its controller holds a session; reveal.ts attaches the ?session= of a reload and the gates open sessions through window.__vm, neither through the window's controls
proposals.rationale: Ten gates and the registry's calls bind panes without a window path; naming them direct keeps the record true about how.

proposals.element: PANE_CLOSED.had_session: the pane showed a session or record
proposals.rationale: v0.7 left had_session undefined for a run's record pane, which has no session id.

proposals.element: WINDOW_BOOTED written at the start of boot, before the registry
proposals.source: web/reveal.ts boot: registry.spawn(1) and the roster loads run before App mounts; S1 requires WINDOW_BOOTED first
proposals.rationale: v0.7's note said after App mounted, which records of pane 1 could precede, breaking S1.

proposals.element: record_context.pane_id: the pane the record is about, not only the controller that emitted it
proposals.source: web/app/App.tsx: the eight PICKER_* emits wrote pane_id null in the context while their payload named the pane; Row.tsx, Transcript.tsx and useScrollAnchor.ts already pass their pane
proposals.rationale: A reader that filters a pane's records by context missed its picker steps; the definition now says what the window's components already do.

proposals.source: web/vm/types.ts ConnectionState: idle | connecting | connected | reconnecting | closed; a bound pane before its session opens is idle
proposals.rationale: The v0.7 enum would have rejected every record of a bound pane whose session had not opened.

proposals.element: PANE_DRAWN.turn_state gains failed; each value defined by the activity line
proposals.source: web/reveal/activity.ts liveActivity: no strip, live, failed (the turn request failed, drawn in red), recap; recap reads ended when the session ended
proposals.rationale: turn_state is the strip's state; a failed turn is drawn differently from a returned one and had no value.

proposals.element: PANE_DRAWN: which optional fields each state carries; written on change
proposals.source: web/app/App.tsx computeViews (pickerViews, session(p)); web/app/PanesView.tsx draws PanePicker or PaneSession
proposals.rationale: A reader comparing two records of a pane needs the same fields each time for the same state.

proposals.element: SIGNAL_REJECTED retired; E2, E5, E6 removed; the vocabulary's names and payload types are generated for the code (web/vm/signals.gen.ts, electron/signals.gen.ts, signals_gen.py)
proposals.rationale: Every tag name and enum value was a raw string at its call site, checked only at runtime by three hand-written checkers. Generated types make the compiler the check; the runtime checkers, their rules and their rejection record go.

proposals.source: web/app/App.tsx: the shell subscription opens meta on the language lens when the focused pane's languageOpenTick rises, which /language bumps (UI sprint 172); componentDidUpdate sets the view from the design tool's view prop (TWEAK_PROPS.view)
proposals.rationale: Two paths change the open view with none of the six causes; without a value for each, those changes would go unwritten.

proposals.element: LENS_CHANGED.lens drops graph: the values are the meta view's five lenses
proposals.source: web/app/MetaView.tsx LENSES: stream+graph (GraphMode.Stream), i/o, structure, language, scene; web/vm/kinds.ts GraphMode has no graph
proposals.rationale: The stream lens draws the stream and its graph as one lens; no lens change could carry graph, so the value named nothing the app does.

proposals.element: RECORD_OPENED.how: open_record | deep_link | run (records_page dropped, run added); outcome decided by the record stream's first open or error
proposals.source: callers of web/vm/session_controller.ts attachRecordRoot: web/reveal.ts (menu open-record; substrate://record/ deep link), web/app/App.tsx openKey (⌘O), attachRun (UI sprint 182 run panes); the records page opens sessions through attachExisting, not records
proposals.rationale: No path attaches a record from the records page, and the run pane, which does, had no value.

proposals.source: web/app/Dialogs.tsx: settings is a dialog (DIALOG_OPENED settings), not a page; web/vm/kinds.ts Surface: records, assay, studio
proposals.rationale: Settings draws as a dialog, which DIALOG_OPENED writes; no page draws it.
